q: How is my gold's price calculated?
a: We weigh your gold, test its purity on an XRF machine and multiply the pure gold by our live rate shown on this page. You see every number before you decide.
No. The XRF test doesn't scratch or melt anything. Your jewellery stays exactly as it is.
Yes. Every piece is photographed before testing, so there is a clear record of exactly what you handed over.

q: Do you offer a free home visit?
a: Yes, across Navi Mumbai, Mumbai and Thane. Our executive comes at a time that suits you, tests your gold in front of you and makes a final offer on the spot.
Yes. Tick "Discreet visit" when you book, and our executive comes in plain clothes, with no logo on the bag or vehicle. At our centre, every visit happens in a private consultation room.

q: Can I ask for a woman executive?
a: Yes. Tick "Woman executive" when you book a home visit. Visiting our centre? Just mention it on WhatsApp.

q: I need money urgently. Can you come today?
a: Yes. Tick "Urgent, same day" when you book a home visit. We call you within 30 minutes, and if you book before 4 pm, we visit you the same day.

q: Is anything charged if I don't sell?
a: No. Everything before you sell is free: the home visit, the testing and the valuation certificate. You sell only if you're happy with the final offer.
Only the weight of the stones, which we measure and show you. No "wastage" cuts and no hidden charges.

q: Do I get my stones back?
a: Yes. Stones and any non-gold parts are removed with care and returned to you. You are paid for the gold.

q: What if my jewellery is broken or not hallmarked?
a: We buy all gold jewellery, including broken, old and non-hallmarked pieces. The XRF test finds the real purity, so you're paid for the gold you actually have.
Instantly, by bank transfer or UPI, as soon as you accept the final offer. We never pay in cash.
Yes. You get an invoice for the sale and a free valuation certificate.
About 15 minutes for most visits. Testing, the final offer and payment all happen in one sitting.
Your Aadhaar and PAN, to confirm your identity.

q: My gold is pledged for a loan. Can you still buy it?
a: Yes. We help release gold pledged with a bank or gold-loan company and buy it at our live rate. WhatsApp us for details.

q: Is it Carat Money or Karat Money?
a: It's Carat Money (carat.money). If you typed Karat Money, you're in the right place: karatmoney.com and karatmoney.in both bring you here.
